Nickit

Dark

Galar · Generation 8

Nickit is a Dark-type Fox Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8.9 kg. It evolves into Thievul. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (52), with a base stat total of 245.
